about: MMTC Limited operates as a trading company in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and North America. It operates through Minerals, Precious Metals, Metals, Agro Products, Coal & Hydrocarbon, Fertilizer, and General Trade/others segments. The company engages in the export of minerals; and import of precious metals, non-ferrous metals, fertilizers, agro products, coal and hydrocarbon, etc. It also trades in minerals, metals, fertilizers, agro products, coal and hydrocarbons, bull
